summary: Churchill Capital Corp XII filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units (each consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one-tenth of a warrant) may elect to separately trade the shares and warrants starting June 17, 2026. The units will continue to trade under CXIIU; shares under CXII; warrants under CXIIW. This is a routine post-IPO administrative step allowing separate trading of components, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event is present.
